_readme: One file per prospect. Files starting with _ are skipped. Saved as prospects/<slug>.json, it builds buildboosters.com/preview/<slug> plus /preview/<slug>/classic, fresh, bold, freeze, edge and earthy. Every field except basics.biz, basics.trade and basics.city is optional; anything missing falls back to the trade template. Never invent reviews, years, licenses or owner names: leave the field out instead.
headline: Miami AC repair
that actually picks up.
services: Same-day diagnosis on most calls, with the price in writing before any work starts.
New Carrier and Trane systems sized for your home, not upsold.

text.heroSub: Family-run AC service for Miami homes since the owner's first truck. Written prices, on-time crews, and a text when we're on the way.
text.svcSub: Not sure what you need? Text a photo of the unit and Carlos will tell you what it takes.
text.note1: Two sentences in the owner's voice, built only from facts in their listing, site or reviews.
text.note2: One more sentence about how they work, again only from real facts.

reviews: Copied exactly from their Google reviews, never written for them.
faq: Answer built from their real service area.
